preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the string n for each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '+-' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of characters '+' and '-'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n + 1) if is_promising(s[i:j])))
postconditions.description: The output must be the count of promising non-empty substrings of string s.
